findings.title: Null path is dereferenced without a guard
findings.evidence: path.relative(undefined, target) throws when target is null
findings.recommendation: Guard against a null target before computing the relative path

findings.title: Missing target validation can crash rendering
findings.evidence: The tests exercise an undefined target that reaches path.relative
findings.recommendation: Validate the target before path operations

findings.title: Output path is not checked before writing
findings.evidence: The generated path is passed directly to writeFileSync
findings.recommendation: Confirm the output remains inside the repository
